class_label: loudspeaker, speaker, speaker unit, loudspeaker system, speaker system
focus_areas: Circularity and symmetry of speaker drivers behind grilles
Legibility of the digital display interface
Structural integrity of the speaker mesh grilles
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Focus heavily on the digital display at the top. AI models often fail to render crisp, legible alphanumeric characters on small screens, resulting in glowing blobs. Verify if the 'text' is actually readable or just decorative noise. Crucially, inspect the circular speaker drivers behind the mesh grilles for perfect circularity and symmetry; AI often introduces subtle elliptical distortion or warping in these repetitive circular structures. Ensure the depth relationship between the grille and the driver cone is physically plausible.
image_description: A close-up, silver-colored home audio stereo system. The central unit features a digital display at the top, a row of control knobs, and two large speaker compartments at the bottom covered by mesh grilles. Behind the grilles, circular speaker drivers (woofers) with central dust caps are clearly visible. Flanking this central unit are partial views of matching satellite speakers or components.
